eslint/no-restricted-properties.message: gc opens a file in a session tree only through openRegularFile (session/regular-file.ts): a name can stand for a FIFO, which a read by name waits on or drains.
Use openRegularFile or createExclusive (session/regular-file.ts): an open by name can block on, or read from, a FIFO.
Use openRegularFile (session/regular-file.ts) and read the descriptor.
Use openRegularFile (session/regular-file.ts) and copy the descriptor: copyFile reads the source by name.
Use openRegularFile (session/regular-file.ts) and read the descriptor.
